title: Luminaires - Particular Requirements - Section 3: Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting
scope: Specifies safety and performance requirements for luminaires used in road, highway, and street lighting applications using electric light sources, including LED arrays, operated on supply voltages up to 1000 V.
description: Primary standard for municipal and highway outdoor street lighting fixtures and LED luminaires.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 1: Ingress Protection (IP66) and Surge Protection Guidelines

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 1: Safety Requirements
scope: Covers safety and interchangeability requirements together with test methods for self-ballasted LED lamps intended for domestic and similar general lighting purposes.
description: Safety requirements for self-ballasted LED bulbs and interior lighting lamps.

title: Method of Electrical and Photometric Measurements of Solid-State Lighting (LED) Products
scope: Provides standardized procedure for measuring total luminous flux, electrical power, luminous efficacy, and chromaticity of solid-state lighting (LED) products for outdoor and indoor applications.
description: Photometric testing standard for verifying luminous efficacy and power factor of LED products.

title: Lamp Controlgear - Particular Requirements for DC or AC Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
scope: Specifies safety requirements for electronic controlgear (LED drivers) for use on DC supplies up to 250 V or AC supplies up to 1000 V at 50 Hz/60 Hz.
description: Electronic controlgear and driver unit safety specification for LED luminaires.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 1: Thermal and Voltage Protection Requirements

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated PVC Sheathed Cables - Part 1: For Working Voltages Up to and Including 1100 V
scope: Specifies requirements for armored and unarmored single-core, twin-core, and multi-core XLPE insulated cables for electricity supply in underground and outdoor power distribution networks.
description: Underground armored XLPE insulated power cables up to 1.1 kV working voltage.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords for Working Voltages up to 1100 V
scope: Covers requirements for single and multi-core PVC insulated copper and aluminum cables used for electrical wiring in industrial and residential installations.
description: General building wiring and flexible PVC insulated cables for electrical installations.

title: Portland Slag Cement - Specification
scope: Covers manufacturing, physical and chemical requirements for Portland Slag Cement (PSC) manufactured by grinding Portland cement clinker and granulated blast furnace slag.
description: Portland Slag Cement specification for heavy structural concrete, foundations, and marine civil works.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification - Part 1: Flyash Based
scope: Specifies requirements for flyash based Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) used in reinforced concrete structures, masonry, and general civil construction works.
description: Flyash based Portland Pozzolana Cement for general civil construction and reinforced concrete.

title: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Water Supply - Specification
scope: Covers requirements for HDPE pipes ranging from 16 mm to 1000 mm nominal outer diameter for potable water supply, municipal drainage, and irrigation pipelines.
description: High-density polyethylene pipes specification for municipal drinking water distribution networks.

title: Submersible Pump Sets for Clear, Cold, Water - Specification
scope: Covers design, constructional requirements, performance parameters, and testing methods for submersible pump sets driven by electric motors for agricultural and drinking water pumping.
description: Submersible motor-driven pump sets for tube wells, borewells, and irrigation water extraction.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
scope: Specifies requirements for design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic (PV) modules suitable for long-term operation in open-air climates.
description: Design qualification and outdoor operational performance standard for crystalline silicon solar PV panels.

title: Outdoor Type Oil Immersed Distribution Transformers Up to and Including 2500 kVA, 33 kV - Specification
scope: Covers requirements for three-phase oil-immersed distribution transformers used in outdoor power distribution systems up to 33 kV voltage level.
description: Oil-immersed step-down power distribution transformers up to 33 kV grid applications.

amendments.title: Amendment No. 1: Energy Efficiency Level Ratings (Level 1, 2, 3)

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers - Performance and Construction - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for design, construction, charging, testing, and performance of portable fire extinguishers of water, foam, powder, and CO2 types.
description: Design, pressure rating, and fire suppression performance standard for portable fire extinguishers.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
scope: Covers requirements for steel plates, sections, flats, bars, and beams intended for use in structural construction of bridges, buildings, and industrial towers.
description: Structural steel specification for bridge construction, high-rise buildings, and industrial frameworks.
